claims.quote: We are an existing customer in construction services. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.draft:
Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your workflow has stopped following a configuration change, and we appreciate your prompt attention to this issue. Our support team is now aware of your situation and will be in touch shortly to assist you in resolving this matter.

Once the issue is resolved, we would be happy to discuss any potential expansion opportunities that may align with your needs.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Position]
Cedar Systems
